title: FPS01
tagline: Maps of half-metre boxes you can blow apart, down to the roof over your head.
back: Everyone is built of a hundred boxes, one for each point of health, and every point of damage drains the colour from one more.
Blow a hole in any wall, floor or pillar, and whatever is cut loose falls, crushing whoever is below.
Six weapons each have a second use: the railgun, charged, fires through a metre of wall.
Jump pads and a grappling hook take you up onto the roofs; put your weapon away to run faster and juggle.
Race to 25 kills, or bring the other team's flag home, on Depot, Canal or Fort, with up to 16 players.
